title: minuartia corymbulosa var. brevifolia
intro: Minuartia corymbulosa var. brevifolia, commonly known as Alpine Pearlwort, is a rare alpine plant species that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Alpine Pearlwort include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and anticancer properties.
